title: ts-forge Package Configuration
description: Per-package overrides for ts-forge build targets. Place as ts-forge.json in a package directory.

targets.description: Target-specific overrides for this package. Keys must match target names in the root ts-forge.config.json.

banner.description: Banner comment for this package's output. Supports ${version} interpolation.

external.description: Additional external dependencies for this package.

transpiler.description: Override the transpiler for this package.

skip.description: Skip this target entirely for this package.
